content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Henderson

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and documented hours leading projects or managing teams. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you assess readiness before you commit.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners cover the full PMBOK framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios across your flexible schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you complete your contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the official PMI exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application portal and required evidence to streamline your submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your four-hour proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After you earn your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning and reporting professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers ongoing webinars and courses that count toward your PDU requirement, keeping your credential current and your skills sharp.
